# T2-hybrid build: the game's code as C (generated by tools/50_recompile.sh into
# A2N_GEN_DIR), the hybrid engine in runtime/, and apple2tc's host (window,
# video, sound, Disk II) from the patched vendor tree.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(a2n_t2 C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(A2N_VENDOR_DIR "" CACHE PATH "vendor/apple2tc-norom-src")
set(A2N_GEN_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Generated t2_gN.c / t2_blocks.c")
if (NOT EXISTS "${A2N_VENDOR_DIR}/include/apple2tc/a2engine.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "A2N_VENDOR_DIR must point at vendor/apple2tc-norom-src")
endif ()
if (NOT EXISTS "${A2N_GEN_DIR}/t2_blocks.c")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "A2N_GEN_DIR has no t2_blocks.c; run tools/lib/t2_link.py")
endif ()

add_subdirectory("${A2N_VENDOR_DIR}" vendor EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

file(GLOB A2N_GEN_SOURCES "${A2N_GEN_DIR}/*.c")
# Generated block code: one large switch per group. -O1 keeps compile time
# reasonable; the warnings are about apple2tc's output, not this project.
set_source_files_properties(${A2N_GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O1;-Wno-unused-variable;-Wno-unused-but-set-variable;-Wno-unused-function")

# a2io's disk2.c embeds Apple's Disk II boot PROM, and a2_io_peek reaches it,
# so dead-stripping cannot drop it. T2 starts from its title-screen image and
# never boots, so it links a copy with the table zeroed; that object defines
# every disk2.c symbol, so the linker never pulls disk2.o from liba2io.a.
set(A2N_DISK2_SOURCE "${A2N_VENDOR_DIR}/lib/a2io/disk2.c")
set(A2N_DISK2_NOPROM "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/a2n_disk2_noprom.c")
file(READ "${A2N_DISK2_SOURCE}" A2N_DISK2_TEXT)
string(REGEX REPLACE "static const uint8_t disk2_boot_rom\\[256\\] = {[^}]*};"
  "static const uint8_t disk2_boot_rom[256] = {0};" A2N_DISK2_STRIPPED "${A2N_DISK2_TEXT}")
if (A2N_DISK2_STRIPPED STREQUAL A2N_DISK2_TEXT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "${A2N_DISK2_SOURCE}: Disk II boot PROM table not found")
endif ()
file(WRITE "${A2N_DISK2_NOPROM}" "${A2N_DISK2_STRIPPED}")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${A2N_DISK2_SOURCE}")

add_executable(a2n-t2
  runtime/a2n_engine.cpp
  runtime/a2n_monitor.cpp
  "${A2N_DISK2_NOPROM}"
  ${A2N_GEN_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(a2n-t2 PRIVATE runtime "${A2N_VENDOR_DIR}/include")
set_source_files_properties("${A2N_DISK2_NOPROM}" PROPERTIES
  INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${A2N_VENDOR_DIR}/lib/a2io")
target_link_libraries(a2n-t2 PRIVATE a2host_gui cpuemu d6502 a2io support)
target_link_options(a2n-t2 PRIVATE -Wl,-dead_strip)
